item.title: Notify NYC - Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert - Xiuqun Fan (NYC)
item.description:
Alert issued 10-08-2026 at 12:42 AM.
A Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert has been issued for Xiuqun Fan, an 83-year-old Asian female from Jericho, Nassau County. The missing has medical conditions and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: 5'3" tall, 110lbs, with gray hair and brown eyes. Wearing a yellow jacket, black pants with blue slippers and walking two small dogs.
Last Seen: Narcissus Avenue at approximately 3:00 PM on 10-08-2026.
If you see the missing person, please call Nassau Co PD - 2nd Precinct at 516-573-7347 or call 9-1-1.
A photo of the missing is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sEYRtp
